afterMarketMisclassification.consequence: Both 23:35 and 23:55 scheduled events fail exact after-market identity and are routed as INTRADAY_MONITOR, then skipped outside intraday hours.

mechanism: PV historical 15m bootstrap runs only inside successful after-market scan flow.
Automatic after-market scan path is not reached under current combined 23:35/23:55 cron identity.
Fallback baseline growth through pvRollObservedSession requires a completed 13:00 slot.
2026-10-05 physical intraday monitoring ended around 11:08, so that date could not roll into baseline.
analyzeStockSmart receives the raw 15m provider response as raw.
result.pvShadow persists only normalized session15, not raw provider response identity.
pvBuildIntradaySnapshot source object omits provider, endpoint and rawPayloadHash.

recommendedSystem1Remediation: Recognize the actual combined 35,55 15 cron as the intended 23:35 primary plus 23:55 recovery after-market family, preserving onlyIfMissing/idempotent behavior.

Decouple research-only 15m baseline bootstrap availability from successful Formal selection completion, or otherwise prove a bounded guaranteed warmup path for currently monitored symbols; expose attempt/range/raw-row/normalized-session/rejection/final-validSessions receipts.
Bind provider, endpoint and a canonical raw payload hash at the 15m fetch boundary before normalization; keep semanticFingerprint separate.
nonRetroactivity: 2026-10-05 remains excluded from clean prospective-date counting after any repair.
